page.overview:
What is Chorus Flower?

Chorus flowers are blocks that grow on chorus plants found in the End. They can be planted on end stone where they grow into new chorus plants.

Chorus flowers can be mined with any tool and drop themselves when broken, but an axe is the quickest. They do not drop anything when pushed by a piston or water, destroyed by a ravager, or when their supporting block (the chorus plant block) is destroyed, since the chorus flowers grows on top of chorus trees. They also drop when hit by a trident, arrow, or snowball, or a fire charge shot from a dispenser.

Chorus flowers are naturally generated in the End at the top of chorus trees, in their fully-grown state.

Chorus flowers are used to grow chorus plants. They can be planted on end stone in any dimension.
